summary: Docebo Inc., a Toronto-based learning-software issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing interim financial statements for the period ended September 30, 2026, with XBRL tags covering balance sheet, equity and property accounts. The XBRL entity data discloses subsidiary references to A365 Talents (a January 2026 acquisition) and Zive GmbH (an April 2026 acquisition), but the excerpt contains only accounting roll-forward detail with no transaction terms, prices, stakes, board recommendations or advisors. No special-situation event is described; watch only for future filings quantifying those bolt-on acquisitions.
